Start date: 1769-05-02.  
Subtract 15 weeks = 15 × 7 = 105 days.  
Plus 6 more days = 111 days total subtraction.  

1769-05-02 minus 111 days:  
April has 30 days → back to 1769-04-02 is 30 days earlier (from May 2).  
111 − 30 = 81 days left to subtract.  
March has 31 days → back to 1769-03-02 is another 31 days.  
81 − 31 = 50 days left.  
February 1769 has 28 days (not leap year) → back to 1769-02-02 is 28 days.  
50 − 28 = 22 days left.  
January has 31 days → 1769-01-31 minus 22 days = 1769-01-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1769-01-09
